title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Copilot label restrictions in Word, Excel and PowerPoint apply wherever the file is stored
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says Microsoft Learn provides no step-by-step instructions inside the sensitivity-label rule. Microsoft publishes those instructions in its education deployment guide. The roadmap facts, licensing, policy behaviour and PowerShell examples are supported; the UI routes stop before the scope and label-rule configuration.

claims.claim: The printed Purview route reaches the Copilot DLP location used to create the policy and scope it to users and groups.
claims.quote: Go to Data Loss Prevention > Policies and select + Create policy. Select the Custom template, then Custom policy. On the Locations page, set the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork location to on.
claims.fix: Keep the documented location path, and add to the note: 'At the Copilot location, choose the users and groups to include or exclude.' This is the scope-selection step described at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-microsoft365-copilot-location-learn-about#admin-units; the printed path stops at the location.

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy -Name "<policy-name>" -Locations $loc -EnforcementPlanes @("CopilotExperiences") creates the Copilot policy with the specified location and scope.
claims.quote: New-DLPCompliancePolicy -Name "Copilot Policy" -Locations $loc -EnforcementPlanes @("CopilotExperiences")

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 Copilot location identifier used in $loc is 470f2276-e011-4e9d-a6ec-20768be3a4b0.
claims.quote: Location: Where the DLP policy applies. For Microsoft 365 Copilot, use the value 470f2276-e011-4e9d-a6ec-20768be3a4b0.

claims.claim: Inclusions and Exclusions in $loc determine which users and groups the policy covers.
claims.quote: Inclusions: Who the DLP policy applies to. ... Exclusions: Exclude security groups, distribution groups, or users from the scope of this DLP policy.

claims.claim: The printed Purview route is the entry route for configuring the sensitivity-label restriction.
claims.quote: Go to Data Loss Prevention > Policies and select + Create policy. Select the Custom template, then Custom policy. On the Locations page, set the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork location to on.
claims.fix: Keep the supported route ending at the Copilot location, but clarify the note with: 'The path reaches the policy location. In the policy, add a rule with Content contains > Sensitivity labels, choose the labels, and set Prevent Copilot and Cowork from processing content.' The condition and action are given at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-microsoft365-copilot-location-learn-about#supported-conditions-and-actions. Remove the separate assertion that Learn gives no rule-level steps.

claims.claim: New-DlpComplianceRule -Policy "<policy-name>" -AdvancedRule $advRule -RestrictAccess @(@{setting="ExcludeContentProcessing";value="Block"}) creates the label-processing restriction rule.
claims.quote: New-DLPComplianceRule -Name "Copilot Rule" -Policy "Copilot Policy" -AdvancedRule $advrule -RestrictAccess @(@{setting="ExcludeContentProcessing";value="Block"})

claims.claim: $advRule specifies the sensitivity-label GUIDs for the restriction.
claims.quote: The second command stores the GUID value of the sensitivity label in the variable named $guidVar. ... The fifth command creates the variable named $advRule. The advanced rule needs to be updated depending on the grouping of labels you want to provide as input.

claims.claim: The policy and rule example is run in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell. ... New-DLPComplianceRule -Name "Copilot Rule" -Policy "Copilot Policy" -AdvancedRule $advrule -RestrictAccess @(@{setting="ExcludeContentProcessing";value="Block"})

claims.claim: Content contains > Sensitivity labels is the condition used on the Copilot location to restrict labelled content.
claims.quote: To set this up, create DLP policies that use the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location with the Content contains > Sensitivity labels condition to exclude items from being processed.

claims.claim: The documented action for the sensitivity-label condition is Prevent Copilot and Cowork from processing content.
claims.quote: | Content contains > Sensitivity labels | Prevent Copilot and Cowork from processing content | Detects when a file or an email in Exchange has a chosen sensitivity label.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Items excluded from content processing can still appear in response citations.
claims.quote: Identified items still appear in the citations of the response, but Copilot and Cowork don't access or use the content of the item in the response.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Copilot does not access or use the excluded item's content in its response.
claims.quote: Identified items still appear in the citations of the response, but Copilot and Cowork don't access or use the content of the item in the response.

claims.where: What's changing; Change & support; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Copilot skills in Word, Excel and PowerPoint are disabled when an open file has a label covered by the processing-prevention policy.
claims.quote: When a file is open in Word, Excel, or PowerPoint and has a sensitivity label for which DLP policy is configured to prevent processing by Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat, the skills in these apps are disabled.

claims.claim: Some experiences that do not reference file content or use large language models are not currently blocked in the user experience.
claims.quote: Certain experiences that don't reference file content or that aren't using any large language models aren't currently blocked on the user experience.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The policy is evaluated at file open in Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
claims.quote: In Word, Excel, and PowerPoint the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy to prevent Copilot from processing content is evaluated at file open.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: A sensitivity label applied mid-session is enforced starting the next time the file is opened.
claims.quote: If a sensitivity label is applied mid-session, the policy will be enforced starting the next time the file is opened.

claims.claim: At the time of writing, Learn does not describe the storage-location extension itself.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Copilot DLP sensitivity labels all storage locations local files separate setting; "Copilot" "DLP" "storage location". Read Copilot DLP, architecture-data-protection-auditing and ai-m365-copilot excerpts; none describes this DLP extension.

claims.where: Why it matters: related encryption behaviour
claims.claim: Copilot honours the same protection settings for labelled or encrypted files outside Microsoft 365 while they are open in an Office app.
claims.quote: When a labeled or encrypted file stored outside Microsoft 365 (for example, on local storage, a network share, or another cloud service) is open in an Office app, Copilot honors the same protection settings.

claims.claim: DLP does not scan the contents of files uploaded directly into prompts.
claims.quote: DLP can't scan the contents of files that you upload directly into prompts, so evaluation of the uploaded file for sensitive data doesn't occur.

claims.claim: For direct prompt input, DLP checks the text typed into the prompt itself.
claims.quote: DLP only checks the text you type into the prompt itself.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts run in the initiating user's security context.
claims.quote: All Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts run in the security context of the user who initiates the prompt.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope: Users
claims.claim: Copilot DLP policy scope follows the user submitting the prompt, not the file owner.
claims.quote: DLP policy scoping for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork is based on the user who submits the prompt, not the owner of a file or email that the experience accesses.

claims.claim: The roadmap record names no new licence for the storage-location extension.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention policy to restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot processing sensitive files in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint will now apply regardless of file storage location.

claims.claim: Learn gives no step-by-step navigation inside the sensitivity-label rule.
claims.quote: 1. Add another rule. 2. Set the condition to Content contains > Sensitivity labels. 3. Select the labels the district wants excluded from Copilot processing. 4. Set the action to Prevent Copilot from processing content. 5. Save the rule and policy.
claims.fix: Remove 'Learn gives no step-by-step navigation inside the rule.' Microsoft provides rule-level steps under 'Protection pattern C — Exclude labeled files and emails from Copilot processing' at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/education/guide/1-reference/purview-data-security-posture-management-education. Keep the existing condition and action names supported by the cited feature page.

claims.claim: The excluded item's citation remains visible only to users with permission to access the item.
claims.quote: This means for a user to see an item in a prompt response, they must first have the necessary permissions to access the content of the item.

claims.claim: Learn documents the label restriction in Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Cowork and Copilot in Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
claims.quote: This feature is available in Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Cowork, and Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
